schema.description: Request schema for setting a user mapping. Exactly one of `external_user_id` or `email` must be provided to identify the external user.

external_user_id.description: The ID of the external user to map to the provider.

email.description: The email address of the external user to map to the provider, matched case-insensitively against the connected account's external users.

schema.title: SetUserMappingRequest
